'''Regulation 449''' was a regulation in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. [[Elara Dorne]], a defector to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], complied with Regulation 449 by reporting in to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kalor (Republic)|Kalor]] of [[Personnel Division of the Army of the Galactic Republic|Personnel Division]].
